Package hadur2.core.melee

Class TeamModes

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.TeamModes
public final class TeamModes extends Object
T7, the team's mode table (TMODE-1): which team movement modes HadurTeam plays against each opposing team, as the 1v1 mode table picks a mode per opponent.

The table is keyed by an opposing member's class (key(java.lang.String)): a team's members share their team's entry, and a team of two classes has an entry for each. A team the table does not name plays every mode forced on (FORCE_...; only MATEFIRE in the shipped build), so an ablation build plays a mode against the whole field and one bench of it scores that mode against every team. The modes act only while Hadur has a living teammate: off a team, or as the last member alive, the controller never asks.

    • FORCE_SOFT

      public static final boolean FORCE_SOFT
      Ablation switches: the mode for every team the table does not name. MATEFIRE is on in the shipped build since team step C (TMODE-12): with WEAVE-9's narrow lane, teammates' bullets fly near more often, and the pair benched +2.9 share points against 3.16.
